title: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest a
question:
List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: If the person A's birthdate < B's birthdate, it means that person B is younger than person A; A11 refers to average salary

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district dist ON c.XCL_012 = dist.XCL_017
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC, dist.XCL_026 DESC
LIMIT 1
